profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with experience in computer science, mathematics, and aeronautical engineering. My areas of expertise include dynamic system creation, user interface design, data processing, and lighter than air vehicles.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for designing and developing new software features. Our team uses an Agile development strategy and we work on a Angular front-end and Java/SQL back-end stack. I have worked on both front-end and back-end development, helping to design a dynamic display system that sped up front-end development by allowing for reuse of several generic components across the entire product.

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description: Ran a class introducing students to programming principles using the Python language. I was responsible for all aspects of running the course. There was a group of three other professors running other sections of the course. I worked with them to ensure that the different sections were equivalent and we advised each other on what we found to work best in our sections.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted in the running of four different classes and mentored a group of 9 foreign graduate students in the college. I administered exams, graded assignments, held office hours, and helped develop course material under the professor running the classes I was assigned to. When mentoring I assisted the students with their coursework, explained different aspects of university life, helped them find local resources, and kept track of their progress through their programs.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was responsible for grading weekly quizzes for a class of 70+ students and administering labs for small groups. There were two lab blocks each week and I oversaw four lab stations in various parts of the building.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was responsible for running a one hour a week break out group of between 20 and 30 students for a Calculus class. We went over in detail the topics covered during the lectures that week and I administered a comprehension quiz, which I graded.
